title: Vermont AI Laws

reading.body:
Vermont's only AI-related law governs synthetic media in elections, not AI development, data centers, or compute.

The law, S0023, passed on 2026-03-10. It requires a disclosure on deceptive and fraudulent synthetic media published, communicated, or distributed within 90 days before a Vermont election. It sets format requirements for the disclosure in images, video, and audio, provides penalties for knowing and intentional violations, gives enforcement and investigation powers to the Attorney General and State's Attorneys, and lets candidates seek injunctive relief.

The pattern is narrow. Vermont has enacted one AI-related law, and it targets political speech rather than the infrastructure of AI. Nothing in the data addresses data centers, electricity demand, or grid interconnection, so it cannot support any claim about compute siting or power in Vermont.

What the data does not cover matters as much as what it does. It records one enacted law and no pending bills, no agency rules, and no local ordinances. A single election-season disclosure requirement says little about how a state of Vermont's size would treat the buildings and power that AI scaling depends on.

Vermont has enacted 1 AI-related law. Each is read from its enrolled text: what it does, who it applies to, when it takes effect, and what it requires.

Enacted AI laws in Vermont

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • S0023: An act relating to the use of synthetic media in elections passed 2026-03-10

    This act requires a disclosure on synthetic media that is deceptive and fraudulent when published, communicated, or distributed within 90 days before an election in Vermont. It sets specific format requirements for the disclosure in images, video, and audio, and provides penalties for knowing and intentional violations. It also gives enforcement and investigation powers to the Attorney General and State's Attorneys, and allows candidates to seek injunctive relief.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Vermont. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
